name: B-spline Volume Representation with Subdivision
definition: A method to represent medical image datasets using B-spline basis functions to allow for smooth interpolation and multi-resolution rendering, avoiding the quality loss of linear interpolation while maintaining interactive rates.
summary: B-spline Volume Representation with Subdivision uses Chaikin subdivision to generate smooth, multi-resolution medical images, offering superior quality over trilinear interpolation by maintaining explicit high-resolution super-resolution data for regions of interest.
